mentions.h: Boys Competition for Mrs. L. Ryan Cup
mentions.note: Mrs. L. Ryan Cup boys' handicap competition: high jump 11 pts, 200m 16 pts, 800m 20 pts, long jump 15 pts, 1,500m 18 pts, shot 13 pts, 100m 15 pts; 4th overall, 84 pts; best total in all eight events apart from the top three
aged 13; Wandsworth School; joined July 1972; 800 metres runner; nickname 'Budgie'
pictured racing cross country, number 353; first letter of 'Gary' faintly printed
